blocking_findings: The private runner replaces the broad bound-controller process barrier with _owned_processes, which recognizes only the count-loss controller/adapter and misses other owned training/resource jobs.
_owned_processes ignores psutil.AccessDenied rather than failing closed; owned Python-process visibility is therefore not guaranteed.

checked_paths.public_validate_queue: temporary schema-faithful fixtures for email and MOOC; numeric-v3 actual schema includes dataset_path
checked_paths.public_run_queue: two mocked child processes; exact adapter argv and pinned-input checks
checked_paths.budget: mocked aggregate reaching the 72-hour boundary blocks spawn

limitations: No actual phase, model, optimizer, real archive/checkpoint load, GPU, or canonical authorization.
No test covers another owned process or AccessDenied; those remain launch blockers.
historical_duration_note: Prior engineering prose reports 30.91s, while its pinned log and JSON report 29.98s; a fresh local run was 29.77s.
